findings.problem: status is a raw String instead of a domain enum, allowing any string value including invalid transitions
findings.failure_mode: LeaseWorkflow can hold status values like "cancelled" while is_sent=true, or any arbitrary string that breaks workflow invariants
findings.fix: Replace `status: String` with a `LeaseStatus` enum (e.g., `New`, `Validated`, `Sent`) that encodes valid states

findings.problem: is_validated: bool is a lifecycle boolean instead of a typestate transition
findings.failure_mode: Boolean flags allow impossible combinations such as is_validated=false combined with is_sent=true, violating the lease lifecycle invariant that sent implies validated
findings.fix: Replace bools with a typestate enum or parameterized type that makes invalid state combinations unrepresentable at compile time

findings.problem: is_sent: bool is a lifecycle boolean instead of a typestate transition
findings.failure_mode: Boolean flags allow impossible combinations such as is_sent=true with status="new", or is_validated=false while is_sent=true
findings.fix: Eliminate is_sent; let the typestate enum variant own the sent state (e.g., `Sent { sent_at_epoch_ms: u64 }`)

findings.problem: sent_at_epoch_ms: Option<u64> is a standalone optional field instead of living inside the enum variant that owns it
findings.failure_mode: Option<u64> can be Some with is_sent=false or status not "sent", creating inconsistent state where timestamp exists without the sent event
findings.fix: Move sent_at_epoch_ms into a variant: `Sent { sent_at_epoch_ms: u64 }` so the timestamp only exists when the lease is actually sent

findings.problem: id: String is a raw primitive instead of a newtyped domain ID
findings.failure_mode: Any String (empty, whitespace, arbitrary bytes) is accepted as a lease ID with no validation, and IDs are interchangeable with other String fields at the type level
findings.fix: Introduce `struct LeaseId(String)` with a smart constructor `LeaseId::new(s: &str) -> Result<LeaseId, Error>` that validates non-empty and rejects malformed input

findings.problem: mark_sent blindly overwrites status to "sent" and sets is_sent=true without checking is_validated or enforcing a typestate transition
findings.failure_mode: A LeaseWorkflow with status="new" and is_validated=false can be sent directly, bypassing the validation step entirely and producing a legally invalid lease
findings.fix: Define `mark_sent` on a typestate-aware enum so it can only be called on validated states; return Result with a typed error when the preconditions are not met

findings.problem: No smart constructor or smart factory exists for LeaseWorkflow; all fields are pub and constructible from any values
findings.failure_mode: Callers can construct LeaseWorkflow with status="", is_validated=false, is_sent=false, id="", sent_at_epoch_ms=Some(0) — a fully hostile initial state that no type system protects against
findings.fix: Make all fields private and provide a single smart constructor like `LeaseWorkflow::new(id: LeaseId) -> Self` that initializes the struct into a known-valid initial state

findings.problem: mark_sent uses `.to_string()` which allocates every call and the function returns a mutated struct by value instead of Result
findings.failure_mode: In a failure scenario (e.g., preconditions not met), there is no error path — the function silently produces an invalid state instead of failing with a typed error
findings.fix: Change signature to `fn mark_sent(item: LeaseWorkflow) -> Result<LeaseWorkflow, LeaseError>` and return `Err(LeaseError::NotValidated)` when validation precondition fails

findings.failure_mode: Without benchmarks, there is no measured baseline for performance claims or regression detection
findings.fix: Add a benchmark directory with criterion or similar, measuring mark_sent allocation patterns and struct mutation cost

findings.failure_mode: The code may not compile or pass lint gates; unverifiable claim of correctness
findings.fix: Run `cargo check --workspace --all-targets --all-features` and `cargo clippy` with strict gates, capture exact command output as evidence
